item_verdicts.write_paths: read the four declared paths against the whole diff — git diff --stat 636909e6 eda7b690 is 4 files, +153/-3, every path inside the fence (tests/test_skill_contracts.py, docs/evidence/archive/reckon-skill-overhaul-landed.html, docs/figures/reckon-skill-overhaul/registration-census-read-set-pinned.svg, docs/plans/reckon-skill-overhaul.html) and no path under skills/ touched, matching the node's no-skill-file-change claim.

justifications.durability: the pin fails under the exact narrowing it guards (verified in memory: the membership assert reddens before the phrase tripwire can run, tests/test_skill_contracts.py:597) but it is a membership pin over three named files rather than set equality, so a later narrowing that keeps exactly those three would stay green — a bound the evidence record and plan comment disclose as the spec's "at least".
justifications.evidence: the three gate logs name revision, tree and command with 56 passed, the base arm records the defect and the head arm its removal under the identical mutation, negative-control.log repeats the declared string verbatim and reddens at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:597, and both recorded SHA-256s match the git objects with the restored file byte-identical to the committed head.
justifications.fit: the assert-with-message loop follows the census test's existing idiom (tests/test_skill_contracts.py:607-612) and the added comment states the mechanism, with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier, attribution or banned name in either the diff or the two commit messages.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_skill_contracts.py:595-604 pins exactly the regression the goal names, and with paths narrowed to [root / "SKILL.md"] that membership assert is the first thing that fails (naming sprint-orchestration.md), so the goal's stated failure is the landed behaviour.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff lies inside the declared write paths, no skills/ file is touched by either commit, and the two cumulative documents gain only their own additive content (+53/-0 and +3/-0, no meta line touched).
